implementation_choices.choice: a supplement, not a re-issue: the depth, repair and intent records are untouched and anchored exactly

implementation_choices.rule: Table II's precedent (no D-282 interval for these arms); D-282 (2)

implementation_choices.choice: counts: depth_d156's eval_positives stream, one matrix for every run (same positives, same order, checked)

binding: the 1% depth record by logs/depth_d156_lora_hw_20260927.sha256 and by repair_d156_<run>'s anchor (itself by logs/repair_d156_4dA_20260930.sha256); at 5% by logs/fpr5_stage_depth_20260928.sha256 and a complete fpr5_self_anchor on that 1% record; 5% layers from the _fpr5 record's own pair_summary; the final name needs every manifest read to be the pinned bytes; each depth record's twomoment_check names the damage record read and its bytes
shared pre side: runs with the same pre repo and revision, axis, C, layer and probe set must give identical TPR-pre replicates

the D-170 flag per row and per file, equal to the depth record's; the hh-harmless rows and that arm's between-arm rows carry D-344's under_check (D-349's count), which is not cleared here; Table III marks them

each cache input's repo ID and revision named in config; every results file read through read_result and listed with its sha256; each cache's resolved path recorded; the final name refuses a set GUARDRAIL_CACHE_DIRS
population groups DEPTH_D156_LORA_D282 and DEPTH_D156_LORA_D282_FPR5, declared when the records are pulled
new analysis code: three reviewers before the run of record

4a's between-arm delta-TPR gap (safety minus general at matched dose, the comparisons the damage record lists), at L*, both probe sets, item level: replicate r is the safety run's delta-TPR replicate minus the general run's (the same draw d_r and counts row r); frozen, D-156 mean and band copied from the damage record and anchored by recomputing them from the two anchored per-draw arrays; the cluster level keeps its band only; in this supplement only, not in Table III

config.level: item_level_D156 (the cluster level keeps its D-156 band only, D-282 (2))
config.layers: every layer where the run's depth record's D-180 rows quote TPR (its pair_summary, item level) and the headline layer L*

table_3.column: delta TPR at L*, selected C, item level: the D-156 mean with this record's combined interval (as Table I's column, D-287)
table_3.under_check: rows with under_check carry a marker and a caption note (D-349)

between_arms.quantity: delta_tpr_gap (safety minus general at matched dose), item level
between_arms.replicate: the safety run's delta-TPR replicate r minus the general run's (the same draw d_r and counts row r)

config.counts: paired.counts_matrix(n positives, n_boot, depth_d156.ITEM_BOOT_SEED['eval_positives']) (depth_d156's CNT_P, a function of n positives); every run has the same eval positives in the same order, so the matrix pairs by item across runs
config.replicates_sha256_of: float64 little-endian bytes, r = 1..n_boot in order

damage_record.kind: each between-arm delta-TPR gap's band summary recomputed from the two anchored per-draw arrays equals the record's as canonical JSON; every depth record read names this record and its bytes (twomoment_check)

anchor.kind: each block's item-level operating point equals the depth record's cell as canonical JSON text, and its per-draw ratio_to_target array hashes to the cell's per_draw_ratio_to_target_sha256 (the draw order); at L* the TPR blocks equal the pair_summary headline's; the 1% depth record is the one the repair record (Table III's frozen column) anchors to

ones_check.kind: counts of all ones give back the D-156 per-draw TPR arrays bit for bit

shared_pre_check.kind: runs sharing the pre model and revision, axis, C, layer and probe set give identical TPR-pre replicates
